title: Non-deterministic CSG crash
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.beta1.mono.official [46c495ca2]
- Not reproducible in: v4.4.1.stable.mono.official [49a5bc7b6]

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta.mono (987832be4) - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2070 SUPER (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-9900 CPU @ 3.10GHz (16 threads) - 31.93 GiB memory

### Issue description

I'm observing non-deterministic crashes using CSGMesh nodes with a specific mesh:
```

```
This error is not deterministic. Sometimes, our scene crashes upon load, sometimes not. Maybe multithreading in `DedupePropVerts` is a factor in this being non-deterministic? 
It seems `DedupePropVerts` has changed with the Manifold update which was included in 4.5.beta1: https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/f3da6201f8f57177150326997655fddc244c7932#diff-f829839b4087efaaea83fc4219269cde9793aae8eb4d11c77a94ecc1955cb7a5R305

The mesh has some overlapping/congruent geometry, but as far as I can tell, is a totally valid manifold mesh. The editor also has no warnings about the CSGMesh nodes.

The green arrow in this screenshot show the overlapping geometry in case it's important for further analysis:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/58fdd5a7-fb12-4a12-9591-0ee1b42684cd)

It's worth noting that in 4.5.beta1, when it doesn't immediately crash, there is broken geometry in exactly this part:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d363b68a-3387-46d0-b5dd-e3d1c341b0bf)

Whereas in 4.4.1, the geometry is whole:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a51ad390-8583-4a4f-82f1-882d34dc11df)


### Steps to reproduce

I've attached a project with the CSG setup from the scene. As described, sometimes just loading the scene is enough to reproduce the crash. In other cases, I can trigger it _almost_ reliably by:
* moving the csg nodes around for a few(!) seconds
* toggling their visibility or 
* deleting some of the smaller nodes
as that seems to recalculate things.
